record.original_question: For a classical solution of the nonlocal kinetic equation (5.2) with bounded source term h and symmetric kernel K satisfying the two-sided fractional ellipticity bounds lambda |v' - v|^{-d-2s} <= K(t, x, v, v') <= Lambda |v' - v|^{-d-2s}, does a Krylov-Safonov-type interior Holder estimate hold? Specifically, can one prove the bound stated in Conjecture 8.2 with constants depending only on dimension, lambda, and Lambda?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 8.2. Assume f : [0, 1] × B1 × Rd → R is a (classical) solution of (5.2) for (t, x, v) ∈ (0, 1] × B1 × B1 and some bounded function h.
Then there are constants α > 0 and C, depending only on dimension, λ and Λ, so that f satisfies the estimate kf kC α ((1/2,1)×B1/2 ×B1/2 ) ≤ C kf kL∞ ([0,1]×B1 ×Rd ) + khkL∞ ([0,1]×B1 ×B1 ) .
As of now, both remain open.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Fix dimension $d\ge 1$, fractional order $s\in(0,1)$, and ellipticity constants $0<\lambda\le\Lambda<\infty$. Let $K:[0,1]\times B_1\times\mathbb{R}^d\times\mathbb{R}^d\to[0,\infty)$ be a measurable kernel that is symmetric in its last two variables, $K(t,x,v,v')=K(t,x,v',v)$, and satisfies the two-sided fractional ellipticity bounds
\[
\lambda\,|v'-v|^{-d-2s}\;\le\;K(t,x,v,v')\;\le\;\Lambda\,|v'-v|^{-d-2s}
\qquad\text{for all }t,x,v,v'.
\]
Consider the nonlocal kinetic equation
\[
\partial_t f + v\cdot\nabla_x f \;=\; \mathrm{p.v.}\!\int_{\mathbb{R}^d}\bigl(f(t,x,v')-f(t,x,v)\bigr)\,K(t,x,v,v')\,dv' \;+\; h(t,x,v),
\]
where $h:[0,1]\times B_1\times B_1\to\mathbb{R}$ is bounded. Suppose $f:[0,1]\times B_1\times\mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}$ is a classical solution of this equation on $(0,1]\times B_1\times B_1$.

Prove or disprove: there exist constants $\alpha>0$ and $C>0$, depending only on $d$, $s$, $\lambda$, and $\Lambda$, such that
\[
\|f\|_{C^{\alpha}((1/2,1)\times B_{1/2}\times B_{1/2})}
\;\le\;
C\Bigl(\|f\|_{L^{\infty}([0,1]\times B_1\times\mathbb{R}^d)}+\|h\|_{L^{\infty}([0,1]\times B_1\times B_1)}\Bigr).
\]
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears in a 2022 survey of open problems on regularity for kinetic equations, where it is explicitly stated as open. A web search did not surface any subsequent work establishing a Krylov–Safonov-type interior Hölder estimate for nonlocal kinetic equations with merely measurable symmetric kernels of fractional order under two-sided ellipticity bounds, so the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.snippet: Discusses Krylov–Safonov theory and its nonlocal extensions; no kinetic-nonlocal analogue with merely measurable kernels listed as resolved.
status_evidence.claim: No nonlocal kinetic Krylov–Safonov Hölder estimate under only two-sided fractional ellipticity is recorded as established.
